notes: Lines per cue now works: a 2- or 3-line setting produces 2- or 3-line captions, including after the review step. Previously review and Apply flattened every cue to one line.
Captions break where the speaker pauses: a cue no longer joins words from both sides of a pause.
A phrase-ending word (है, হল, ছিল …) moves to the next line with the word it completes instead of making line 1 too long. Bengali হল/হলো/হলাম/হলেন are now recognised.
Editing line breaks in the review no longer resets word timings. Saved keys, presets and caption settings are preserved.
